narrative: The bill, on the bookwheel. A black-letter bill at the door. Title, house, and hour. No author's name. His name is not on it. The bill, on the bookwheel. The lower line. No sum. The bill is the afternoon's, and the morning's work is over.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the title and left the Theatre.

entities.name: The Comedy of Errors
entities.context: Shown on bill in Errors, and he is not in it
